verdict.rationale: Rollbar has two relevant features. Its own AI agent, Resolve, takes a production error and opens a pull request for review, and its notification rules automatically push to webhooks and PagerDuty when triggers fire. The evidence does not show that Resolve can be set up to run unattended on its own triggers or schedule, so only event-triggered alerting is clearly autonomous. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable background triggers or schedules for the Resolve agent, a general automation/workflow builder, and independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Resolve is an AI agent in Rollbar that takes a production error and produces a pull request you can review.
Resolve writes a tested fix and opens the pull request for you to approve.
Webhooks can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels
Rollbar can create, update, and resolve Incidents in PagerDuty.
